editorial.blurb: Big Jones delivers refined Southern and Creole cooking with genuine care, where even the simplest dishes like fried chicken and grits achieve a level of mastery that keeps locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the rhubarb dishes when in season (spring) — they're exceptional and worth timing your visit around. Ask for the grits with cheese, and consider adding a side if you're very hungry, as plating emphasizes elegance over portion size.
signatureDishes: Fried green tomatoes with shrimp remoulade
